metadata.article_title: Division of property where there is no relative entitled to succeed under the other provisions of this Chapter.

article.title: Division of property where there is no relative entitled to succeed under the other provisions of this Chapter.
article.content:
56Division of property where there is no relative entitled to succeed under the other provisions of this Chapter.

Section 56  ·  Part V · Chapter III  ·  page 27 of the Act
Where there is no relative entitled to succeed under the other provisions of this Chapter to the property of which a Parsi has died intestate, the said property shall be divided equally among those of the intestate’s relatives who are in the nearest degree of kindred to him.]
